description: This file declares the TpmStorage class, which manages data stored inside a TPM with an external index. It includes methods for checking key existence, reading, writing, and allocating storage, and references external TPM and JSON utilities.
external_methods: Result<void> Write(const std::string& key, const StorageData& data)
Result<void> Allocate(const std::string& key, uint16_t size)

classes.name: TpmStorage
classes.description: A class managing TPM-stored data with an external index, providing key existence checks, read/write operations, and handle management.
